# Menus and Sidebar

The menu bar and sidebar are always present, regardless of the active screen. This chapter covers both, plus the dialogs they open.

## Menus

![](assets/menus-overview.png)

### File Menu

- **New Database…**: see [Home Screen](home-screen.qmd).
- **Open Database…**: see [Home Screen](home-screen.qmd).
- **Load Sample Data…**: generates a realistic, randomized fleet. See [Home Screen](home-screen.qmd).
- **Recent**: a submenu listing your recently opened databases, same list shown on the Home screen.
- **Close Database**: returns to the Home screen without closing OdsLog itself.
- **Exit**: closes the application.

### Database Menu

- **Database Details…**: metadata for the *currently open database specifically*, not application-wide settings. Covers:
  - Company/operation name
  - Default currency and default fuel unit
  - The due-soon threshold percentage used by the Dashboard
  - Fiscal year start
  - Whether archived logs should be purged when the database closes (this option exists but is not enforced yet -- toggling it does not currently do anything)

  Schema version, app version, and creation date are also shown here, read-only.

### Help Menu

- **User Manual**: opens this manual in your default browser.
- **About OdsLog…**: version, schema version, and a link to the project's repository.
- **License…**: full license text for OdsLog itself and every third-party library it's built on (PySide6/Qt, matplotlib, openpyxl), viewable without a network connection.

## Sidebar

![](assets/sidebar.png)

The sidebar has two parts:

- **Navigation**: [Dashboard](dashboard.qmd), [Fleet](fleet.qmd), [Service](service.qmd), and [Reports](reports.qmd).
- **Settings** (gear icon, bottom left): *app-wide* preferences, separate from anything tied to a specific database:
  - App date format and report date format (changes require a restart to take effect)
  - UI scale, for high-DPI displays (changes require a restart to take effect)
  - Developer debug bar toggle
  - Recent databases list, with an option to clear it

Company name, currency, and fiscal year settings live under **Database Details**, not in Settings. Settings only ever affects how OdsLog looks and behaves locally, never the contents of a specific database.
